_comment: Per-subject curation for the Elite Ibirapema Warrior unit-analysis video. The METHOD lives in code; this file holds only Ibirapema-specific choices.
_ingame_note: TWO pins, 2026-07-27, both from recorded tapes. (1) 20 Ibirapema vs 21 Warrior Priest -> 0 Ibirapema, 5 Warrior Priests at 382hp: the sim called it an Ibirapema win (wr 0.8) — the same unexplained Warrior Priest gap that has bitten the ETG before. (2) 10 Ibirapema vs 21 Elite Skirmisher -> Ibirapema WINS with 8 of 10 alive (528hp) and all 21 skirmishers dead: the sim calls this a loss (S -42 before the CATCH fix, still -11 after), so the engine remains wrong about a melee unit running down a SLOWER kiter (skirmisher 0.96 vs Ibirapema 1.1). This is the user's original objection and it is correct — the CATCH fix narrowed the gap without closing it. Everything else is the engine's own answer; 10 of 12 filmed fights matched on the first take.
_coinflip_note: Bulgarians/hussar is filmed OUT: two tapes split (14v21 -> Ibirapema 0u vs 3 Hussars at 125hp; a second run -> Ibirapema 4u/78hp vs 0 Hussars). Genuinely bimodal, so it is a bad showcase fight. Left unpinned — the sim's loss call sits inside the coin-flip band.
